title: Dutch Vegetable Casserole
description: A satvik-friendly, resinous and fluffy Dutch dish made with cream of tartar and cooked in papillote, perfect for meal prep. This casserole features a variety of vegetables and is suitable for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced carrots, Brussels sprouts, and potatoes with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, mix the chopped onions and minced garlic.
Add the cream of tartar to the onion mixture and stir well.
In a large Dutch oven or casserole dish, create a layer of the vegetable mixture.
Add a layer of the onion mixture on top of the vegetables.
Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used, ending with a layer of vegetables on top.
Cover the dish with papillote or aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the papillote or foil and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
